name: multi-search-plus
description: Aggregated search across 17 engines (8 CN + 9 global). Includes a runnable Python aggregator (scripts/multi_search.py) for parallel fan-out, dedup, and JSON/Markdown output — LLM can also call web_fetch directly on each engine URL.
description_zh: 集成 17 个搜索引擎（8 国内 + 9 国际），无需 API Key。包含可直接运行的 Python 聚合脚本（scripts/multi_search.py），支持并行调度、去重、JSON/Markdown 输出。LLM 也可直接用 web_fetch 调各引擎 URL。
description_en: Aggregated search across 17 engines (8 CN + 9 global) with zero API keys. Includes a runnable Python aggregator for parallel fan-out and structured output.
